parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the request and response. Default value: **zh\_cn**. Valid values:

- **zh\_cn**: Chinese.

- **en\_us**: English.

parameters.name: TemplateId
parameters.description:
The ID of the industry template.

> You can call the [DescribeCategoryTemplateList](~~2399296~~) operation to obtain the ID of the industry template. If you do not specify this parameter, the list of models for the primary template is returned by default.
